newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London higher, volume remains light.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London higher, volume remains light.

text.p: U.S. shares were mostly firmer following Wall Street's record finish last Friday but trading volumes remained thin as many European investors were absent ahead of the New Year holiday, dealers said.
"Things are still pretty quiet but we have seen a little buying this morning," one market maker said. "We should see the Dow start higher again today -- the market is quite confident."

The Dow industrials finished 14.23 points higher on Friday at a fresh closing record of 6,560.91. The S&P 500 futures contract on the Globex after-hours trading system was up 1.35 points at 765.95 by 1040 GMT.
Oil shares led the advance as investors anticipated strong fourth quarter earnings for the sector in the wake of firm crude prices, dealers said.
"The market is expecting Q4 earnings to jump by 10-20 percent, depending on the company. The price of crude has soared over 30 percent this year which should help the bottom line," one dealer said.
Exxon was up $3/8 at $100-1/4, Atlantic Richfield up $1/2 at $136-7/8, and Texaco rose $1/4 at $99.
